mintAuthority.summary: dUSD mint authority is now enumerated on all four deployments. Every chain runs a transparent proxy whose ProxyAdmin is governed by a 3-of-5 Safe behind a 1-day TimelockController on Ethereum, Fraxtal and Katana, while Sonic's ProxyAdmin and token DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE sit directly under a 2-of-4 Safe with no timelock. Six contracts hold MINTER_ROLE across the four tokens and the dUSD token exposes no supply cap, so authorized minting is economically unbounded.

controls.label: dTRINITY AMO Manager (peg operations controller)
controls.evidence: The docs-registry AMO Manager holds MINTER_ROLE on the Ethereum dUSD token (hasRole = true, re-verified 2026-07-20; RoleGranted event at block 23987067). It mints dUSD directly for algorithmic market operations against the Collateral Vault 0x84c58066a4408454b7380f168c95F571419253f4. Note: dTRINITY's registry documents an AMO only — no separate 'SMO' controller exists.

controls.label: dTRINITY second MINTER_ROLE holder (undocumented in registry)
controls.evidence: A second contract (5,738 bytes of code) holds MINTER_ROLE on the Ethereum dUSD token (hasRole = true, re-verified 2026-07-20; granted by event at block 23983666). It is not listed in dTRINITY's docs contract registry (flagged); its function is otherwise unidentified, but its mint capability is live and identical in kind to the AMO Manager's.

controls.label: dTRINITY Timelocked Governance 3-of-5 Safe (1-day TimelockController)
controls.evidence: dUSD DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is held by the OZ v5 TimelockController 0x18cb0eb73d953ed20f2157ce6bde2a85e30e681b (getMinDelay() = 86,400 s; hasRole verified 2026-07-20) whose sole proposer and executor is this 3-of-5 Safe (owners read on-chain). Through the timelock the Safe can grant/revoke MINTER_ROLE and administer the dUSD proxy-admin chain. On Sonic the same Safe holds DEFAULT_ADMIN directly with no timelock (flagged).

controls.label: dTRINITY Emergency Governance 5-of-5 Safe (PAUSER_ROLE)
controls.evidence: This 5-of-5 Safe (owners read on-chain 2026-07-20) holds PAUSER_ROLE on the Ethereum dUSD token (granted at block 25112809; hasRole re-verified 2026-07-20) — emergency pause only, no mint or admin capability.

controls.label: dTRINITY Fraxtal dUSD MINTER_ROLE holder A
controls.evidence: RoleGranted(MINTER_ROLE) at Fraxtal block 28,872,499 with no matching RoleRevoked; hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0x9e8d87…) = true re-read at block 38,877,208 on 2026-07-20. The holder is a 10,734-byte contract (not an EOA, not a proxy).

controls.label: dTRINITY Fraxtal dUSD MINTER_ROLE holder B
controls.evidence: RoleGranted(MINTER_ROLE) at Fraxtal block 28,872,499 with no matching RoleRevoked; hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0x57bbd5…) = true re-read at block 38,877,208 on 2026-07-20. The holder is a 19,540-byte contract. Three earlier Fraxtal minters (0x0f5e3d…, 0x80fd39…, 0x823fd0…, 0x1ec13e…, 0xd95f1c…) were revoked on-chain and are not active.

controls.label: dTRINITY Fraxtal Governance 3-of-5 Safe (1-day TimelockController)
controls.evidence: Fraxtal dUSD DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is held by TimelockController 0x0bafada2a5824864720873ee40cd960b36445212 (hasRole = true; getMinDelay() = 86,400 s), which also owns the Fraxtal ProxyAdmin 0x1e5be5059d4a95297604355dc6abd0baf036cc95. That timelock's sole PROPOSER, EXECUTOR and CANCELLER is this Safe (RoleGranted events at Fraxtal block 35,709,939; getOwners/getThreshold read 2026-07-20 = 3-of-5, no modules, zero guard). Its owner set is identical to the Ethereum governance Safe.

controls.label: dTRINITY Katana dUSD MINTER_ROLE holder
controls.evidence: The single RoleGranted(MINTER_ROLE) event on the Katana dUSD token (block 11,001,261) has no matching RoleRevoked; hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0xfdb85f…) = true re-read at block 37,822,317 on 2026-07-20. The holder is an 11,760-byte contract.

controls.label: dTRINITY Katana Governance 3-of-5 Safe (1-day TimelockController)
controls.evidence: Katana dUSD DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is held by TimelockController 0x18cb0eb73d953ed20f2157ce6bde2a85e30e681b (hasRole = true; getMinDelay() = 86,400 s), which also owns the Katana ProxyAdmin 0xe8829ff0db7dd1ff727a6052f419dcaceda9d962. hasRole(PROPOSER/EXECUTOR/CANCELLER) on that timelock is true only for this Safe; getOwners/getThreshold read 2026-07-20 = 3-of-5, no modules, zero guard. The address matches the Ethereum deployment but is a chain-local Safe.

controls.label: dTRINITY Sonic dUSD MINTER_ROLE holder
controls.evidence: RoleGranted(MINTER_ROLE) at Sonic block 43,166,024 with no matching RoleRevoked; hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0x9b93c3…) = true re-read at block 76,243,494 on 2026-07-20. The earlier Sonic minter 0x5e8352… was revoked at block 42,123,733. The active holder is an 11,760-byte contract.

controls.label: dTRINITY Sonic Governance 2-of-4 Safe (no timelock)
controls.evidence: Sonic is the weakest deployment: this Safe holds dUSD DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE directly (hasRole = true) and owns the Sonic ProxyAdmin 0x0a0808f20743278d566fc954d3dcf8c082fb0bc5 with no TimelockController in the path. getOwners/getThreshold read at block 76,243,494 on 2026-07-20 return 4 owners and threshold 2 — a lower quorum and shorter delay than the 3-of-5 plus 1-day timelock used on Ethereum, Fraxtal and Katana.

review.evidence: EIP-1967 implementation and admin slots, ProxyAdmin owner(), TimelockController getMinDelay()/hasRole(), Safe getOwners()/getThreshold()/getModulesPaginated()/guard-slot, and token hasRole(MINTER_ROLE)/hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) were read on public RPCs on 2026-07-20 at Ethereum block 25,575,127, Fraxtal 38,877,208, Katana 37,822,317 and Sonic 76,243,494; live MINTER_ROLE holders were derived from the full RoleGranted/RoleRevoked log history on Fraxtal, Katana and Sonic. Active minters: two on Ethereum, two on Fraxtal, one on Katana, one on Sonic. Upgrade and role authority resolves to a 3-of-5 Safe behind a 1-day timelock on Ethereum, Fraxtal and Katana, and to a 2-of-4 Safe with no timelock on Sonic (flagged as the binding worst-case path, so the profile records delaySec 0). The dUSD token exposes neither cap() nor maxSupply() (both revert), so a MINTER_ROLE holder faces no token-level supply ceiling and economicCapSemantics is unbounded. Residual, deliberately not extrapolated: the second Ethereum MINTER_ROLE holder 0xf84cc8217713a53fc3e3eb2d62d2af33a084ff85 is absent from the issuer contract registry and exposes no identifying view function, so its internal collateral checks are unknown; any such check can only narrow, never widen, the uncapped mint capability already scored here.
